title: List owners
description: Page through the portal's owners: the users records can be assigned to.

config.label: Email
config.description: Only the owner with this email.

config.label: Page size
config.description: How many records per page, 1 to 100. HubSpot's own default is 10.

config.label: After (cursor)
config.description: The cursor from the previous page's paging.next.after. Leave empty for the first page.

outputShape.description: The OWNER id, which is what hubspot_owner_id on a record holds. Not the user id.
The HubSpot USER id, a different number from the owner id.
Pass this as "after" for the next page. Absent on the last page.
